def transform(grid):
    # The single-color divider separates two equal-width panels. Keep the
    # overlap of the marked cells in the panels, recolored to 2.
    divider = next(c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[c] != 0 for row in grid))
    left = [row[:divider] for row in grid]
    right = [row[divider + 1:] for row in grid]
    return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(lrow, rrow)]
            for lrow, rrow in zip(left, right)]

def transform(grid):
    # A full-color divider separates two aligned masks. Mark cells where
    # both sides are non-background; recolor their overlap to 2.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_row = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                    if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0), None)
    if sep_row is not None:
        top, bottom = grid[:sep_row], grid[sep_row + 1:]
        return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(ra, rb)]
                for ra, rb in zip(top, bottom)]
    sep_col = next((c for c in range(w)
                    if all(grid[r][c] != 0 for r in range(h)) and
                    len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1), None)
    if sep_col is not None:
        left = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
        right = [row[sep_col + 1:] for row in grid]
        return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(ra, rb)]
                for ra, rb in zip(left, right)]
    raise ValueError('No uniform divider found')
